lines.t: **Verse 1**
Every part of me
You crafted carefully
Before I knew my name
You knew who I would be
You see the things I hide
The thoughts I keep inside
And somehow through it all
You never leave my side
**Pre-Chorus**
I don't even have to say it
For You to understand
Before I speak a single word
You already know my heart
**Chorus**
You know my fears, You know my name
You know my joys, You know my pain
Every part of me, You see
And still You choose to stay with me
You know the questions in my mind
The things I leave unsaid sometimes
You know the heart inside of me
And love me endlessly
**Verse 2**
You know the dreams I have
The things I'm reaching for
You know the times I'm confident
And when I'm insecure
You know when I am strong
You know when I am weak
And when I don't know what to say
You hear the words I cannot speak
**Chorus**
You know my fears, You know my name
You know my joys, You know my pain
Every part of me, You see
And still You choose to stay with me
You know the questions in my mind
The things I leave unsaid sometimes
You know the heart inside of me
And love me endlessly
**Bridge**
Nothing I could ever hide
Could make You turn away
You have known me from the beginning
And You love me just the same
So I don't have to be afraid
I don't have to pretend
The God who knows me completely
Will never let me go
**Final Chorus**
You know my fears, You know my name
You know my joys, You know my pain
Every part of me, You see
And still You choose to stay with me
You know the questions in my mind
The things I leave unsaid sometimes
You know the heart inside of me
And love me endlessly
